target_metric: T-LATERAL-DUAL-CURVATURE-SIGN — source fix: signed GT curvature from Unity + signed reference_point["curvature"]
target_track: all tracks (every consumer of the reference curvature)
approach: Two layers. (1) Unity GroundTruthReporter.GetPathCurvature: the heading-change sign dotted the cross product with Vector3.forward; the ground plane is XZ with +Y up (every other frame computation uses Vector3.Cross(Vector3.up, dir) and Atan2(x, z)), so Dot ≈ 0 and Mathf.Sign(0) = +1 → unsigned on every recording. Fixed to Vector3.up and negated to the map's +left convention; verified by rebuild + runs: sweeping (all left) +0.0033 on every arc frame, mixed (all right) −0.0050. (2) Orchestrator: reference_point["curvature"] took its sign from the planner's UNSIGNED value first; new pure function select_reference_curvature_sign with kill-switch trajectory.reference_curvature_sign_source (planner = legacy | gt_map = signed GT/map first). 5 unit tests.
fix_level: DESIGN (one convention per physical quantity, converted at the source)
hypothesis: Every consumer (LMPC camera kappa_ref bias guards, local-curve-reference direction, Stanley legacy FF source, recorded trajectory/reference_point_curvature) receives a signed +left curvature; PP unaffected (it re-signs by heading).
outcome: CONFIRMED — no regression on six tracks; signs correct at every layer
root_cause_detail: Wrong up-axis in one sign computation (Unity) + an unsigned planner value consulted first (orchestrator).
